description: The task level: which jobs are running, ready or parked and for which workflow, how fast they finish, how often they fail, and what kind of failure it is.

panels.title: Jobs running
panels.description: Tasks a worker is executing now.

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, status) (scheduler_tasks{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", status="running"}))

panels.title: Jobs ready
panels.description: Tasks whose dependencies are met and that are waiting for a worker.

panels.title: Waiting for approval
panels.description: Approval gates parked until someone approves or rejects them.

targets.expr: sum(max by (namespace, status) (scheduler_tasks{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", status="awaiting_approval"}))

panels.title: Job failure ratio
panels.description: Tasks that exhausted their retries, as a share of all finished tasks, over the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum(rate(scheduler_tasks_failed_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / (sum(rate(scheduler_tasks_succeeded_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) + sum(rate(scheduler_tasks_failed_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])))

panels.title: Job duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile task wall time over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Task attempts rescheduled for another try in the selected time range.

panels.title: Jobs in progress by workflow
panels.description: Tasks that have not finished, by the workflow they belong to.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_active_tasks{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}))

panels.title: Jobs in progress by status
panels.description: Pending is waiting on dependencies, ready is waiting for a worker, running is executing, awaiting_approval is parked at a gate.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_active_tasks{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow"}))

panels.title: Jobs in progress
panels.description: One row per workflow with unfinished tasks.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_active_tasks{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"running"}))
sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_active_tasks{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"ready"}))
sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_active_tasks{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"pending"}))

sum by (workflow) (max by (namespace, workflow, status) (scheduler_workflow_active_tasks{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", workflow=~"$workflow", status=~"awaiting_approval"}))

panels.title: Ready jobs by runner class
panels.description: The dispatch backlog split by the pool that must serve it. A class no engine serves only ever grows.

targets.expr: sum by (runner_class) (max by (namespace, runner_class) (scheduler_ready_tasks_by_class{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Job failure ratio
panels.description: Failed over failed plus succeeded. The dashed lines are 1% and 5%.

panels.title: Job duration
panels.description: Task wall time from claim to finish, measured in the worker.

panels.title: Job duration distribution
panels.description: Finished tasks per duration bucket. The top bucket is 300 seconds; longer tasks land in +Inf.

panels.title: Failed attempts by disposition
panels.description: Who owns the failure. Infrastructure is hardware, storage or a lost node; application is the job's own code or configuration; platform is preemption, walltime or cancellation; unknown is a recognised symptom with no clear owner.

panels.title: Failed attempts by class
panels.description: Classified failed attempts in the selected time range, largest first. An attempt is counted whether or not it was retried; a failure whose output matches no signature is not counted here.

panels.title: Cache hits
panels.description: Tasks answered from the memoization cache instead of running, and that as a share of all tasks resolved.

panels.title: Oldest ready job by runner class
panels.description: How long the longest-waiting task in each class has been ready. The dashed line is five minutes.

targets.expr: max by (runner_class) (max by (namespace, runner_class) (scheduler_ready_oldest_age_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))
